You will join a young and dynamic team.
 

Be sure to apply if you are interested!
 

 
 

 

 
 

 
• You are a worker with several years of experience in tiling

You translate business needs into high-quality data solutions. You bring structure: definitions, models, principles, and dashboards that are correct, performant, and easy to adopt.

What you’ll do

• Analyse business needs and translate them into data models and KPI definitions
• Contribute end-to-end to BI initiatives:
• data platform design/implementation, ETL, dashboard development & maintenance
• Help establish and apply BI standards (governance, definitions, “single source of truth”)
• Engage with stakeholders: advise, align, challenge assumptions, and guide decisions
• Stay on top of BI/DataViz evolutions and share knowledge within the team

You are someone who…

• Takes ownership and enjoys solving problems end-to-end (that is why we are also looking for freelance colleagues)
• Communicates clearly with both business and technical stakeholders
• Works well in a team, while also being able to deliver independently
• Cares about quality: correctness, performance, maintainability, and clarity

Skills we’re looking for

Must-have

• Experience with data platform and data modelling
• Solid understanding of data architecture
• Strong affinity with BI & data visualisation (dashboards that drive action)
Nice-to-have

• Any experience with visualization tools such as Power BI
• Experience with Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC) or Looker

Languages

• Fluent in Dutch or French, with a strong knowledge of English

The role:

As a Data Engineer, you translate complex data challenges into high-quality, end-to-end data solutions. You understand the customer's needs and easily navigate complex data environments. Your pipelines and data structures are correct, performant, and built to last.

What you’ll do:

• Analyse business needs and translate them into powerful data formats, flows, and models.
• Design, implement, and maintain robust Data Warehouses and ETL infrastructures.
• Develop, test, and optimize ETL jobs to seamlessly integrate multiple data sources.
• Collaborate with the team to focus on innovation and continuous improvement of our data structures.
• Stay on top of data engineering evolutions and share knowledge within the team.
﻿

You are someone who…

• Takes ownership and enjoys solving complex data problems end-to-end.
• Communicates clearly with both business and technical stakeholders.
• Collaborates naturally, works well in a team, while also being able to deliver independently.
• Cares about quality: you have a sharp eye for correctness, performance, maintainability, and clarity, always striving for the best solution.
• Is eager to learn: you have an inquisitive mind and a healthy hunger for innovation.

Skills we’re looking for

Must-have:

• Knowledge and hands-on experience with ETL processes and building data pipelines.
• Solid experience with Data Warehouse environments and data architecture.
• Strong programming skills and solid experience with SQL querying.
Nice-to-have:

• Knowledge of specific data modeling methodologies like Data Vault or Kimball.
• Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, Google BigQuery, or Oracle.
• Hands-on experience with ETL tools or the implementation and maintenance of dashboards.

Languages:

• Fluent in Dutch or French, with a strong knowledge of English.

Are you a night owl with a talent for solving technical challenges?

Do you thrive in a modern production environment where teamwork and quality are top priorities? Then this is the opportunity for you!

Your role

As a Maintenance Technician in the fixed night shift, you are essential to our production process. You ensure that machines operate at their best, perform preventive maintenance, and resolve malfunctions quickly and effectively. With your technical skills and problem-solving mindset, you keep the production running even while the world sleeps.

What will you do?

• Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance on machines and installations.

• Detect, analyze, and fix malfunctions (primarily electrical, ideally with mechanical expertise).

• Start up and optimize production lines.

• Actively contribute to improving the reliability and efficiency of the equipment.

• Collaborate with a team and report to the technical service manager.

Work schedule

• 2 workdays (2 x 7.36 hours) and 2 weekend days (2 x 11 hours), offering a steady yet varied schedule.

 

 

• A technical degree or relevant experience in a production environment.

• Broad technical knowledge of mechanics, electricity, and pneumatics; PLC knowledge is a plus.

• A flexible, positive attitude and strong problem-solving skills.

• A team player who is eager to learn and improve.

• Fluency in Dutch or English.

Are you an experienced procurement professional looking to make an impact in a dynamic international aviation environment? As a Senior Purchaser, you will play a key role in ensuring the availability of critical parts and materials that keep our helicopter operations running safely and efficiently worldwide.

Acting as the link between operational departments and our supplier network, you will balance urgent operational requirements with commercial performance, supply continuity, quality, lead times and cost efficiency. In addition to day-to-day purchasing activities, you will help drive continuous improvement across our procurement processes, supplier strategies and supply chain performance.

👉Please note that this is an expression of interest only. We are currently building a talent pool for future opportunities and are not actively recruiting for this position at this time.

Your responsibilities include:

• 
Managing strategically important supplier relationships and acting as the main point of contact for supplier-related matters. 

• 
Driving supplier performance improvements focused on service levels, lead times, cost efficiency and overall performance.

• 
Collaborating with internal stakeholders to resolve supplier performance issues and ensure continuity of supply. 

• 
Managing procurement activities, purchase orders and supplier agreements while ensuring compliance with agreed terms.

• 
Monitoring open purchase orders and proactively following up to avoid operational delays. 

• 
Maintaining accurate purchasing records and ERP system data.

• 
Providing support for Aircraft on Ground (AOG) situations and participating in the on-call rotation approximately every 4 to 5 weeks.

• 
Acting quickly on urgent procurement requests to minimize aircraft downtime. 

• 
Supporting the development of procurement processes, supplier strategies and supply chain initiatives.

• 
Identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, supplier performance and cost control across the organization.

We are looking for a proactive and commercially minded procurement professional who thrives in a fast-paced operational environment and enjoys building strong supplier relationships.

You bring:

• 
A bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience. 

• 
Previous experience in a purchasing role. 

• 
Experience working with ERP systems such as Navision or SAP. 

• 
Strong negotiation and influencing skills. 

• 
Professional proficiency in English; French is considered an advantage.

• 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• 
Good IT skills and digital literacy.

• 
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. 

• 
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

• 
The ability to remain flexible and resilient under pressure.

• 
A collaborative approach and the ability to build strong relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders.

Are you ready to begin or further develop your career in procurement within an international aviation environment? As a Junior Purchaser, you help ensure that the parts and services needed for our base and line maintenance activities are available at the right time, in the right place and at the best possible cost.

Working closely with experienced purchasers, internal stakeholders and suppliers, you will support an accurate and reliable purchasing process. You will follow up open orders, maintain procurement data and help resolve delivery issues in accordance with our internal procedures.

👉Please note that this is an expression of interest only. We are currently building a talent pool for future opportunities and are not actively recruiting for this position at this time.

Your responsibilities include:

• 
Creating and managing purchase orders while checking pricing, accuracy and compliance with agreed terms and internal procedures.

• 
Monitoring open purchase orders and following up with suppliers to support the timely delivery of parts and services.

• 
Maintaining accurate purchasing records, supplier information and data within our ERP and procurement systems.

• 
Identifying and escalating potential delays, discrepancies and supply risks.

• 
Acting as a day-to-day contact for suppliers regarding order status, delivery information and discrepancies.

• 
Supporting the resolution of late deliveries, shortages and other delivery-related issues.

• 
Assisting with supplier performance monitoring and collecting information for follow-up actions.

• 
Working closely with colleagues in purchasing, maintenance, logistics and other internal departments.

• 
Contributing ideas to improve order follow-up, data quality, team efficiency and service levels.

• 
Gradually building your procurement knowledge and taking ownership of purchasing activities.

You will also participate in the Aircraft on Ground, or AOG, on-call rotation approximately once every four to five weeks. During these time-critical situations, you will coordinate with suppliers, logistics providers and internal teams to help minimize aircraft downtime. This out-of-office-hours support can be provided remotely from home.

We are looking for an accurate, proactive and motivated colleague who is eager to learn and develop within an international procurement environment.

You bring:

• 
A bachelor’s degree or an equivalent level gained through experience.

• 
Initial experience in purchasing, supply chain, logistics or an administrative role, which is considered an advantage.

• 
Experience with an ERP system such as Navision or SAP, or a willingness to learn.

• 
Professional proficiency in English.

• 
Knowledge of French is considered an advantage.

• 
Good written and verbal communication skills.

• 
Good IT skills and digital literacy.

• 
An interest in developing your negotiation and influencing skills.

• 
Strong organizational and analytical abilities.

• 
A proactive, solution-oriented and results-driven approach.

• 
Attention to detail and the ability to remain flexible under pressure.

• 
A collaborative mindset and the ability to build professional relationships.

• 
A genuine willingness to learn and grow within the role.

We are looking for a warehouse worker for a company in Wavre specializing in acoustic and vibration isolation solutions for buildings and industrial equipment. You hold a valid forklift truck certificate.

Your tasks:

 

 
• You perform and coordinate all inbound logistics activities, including receiving, inspection, registration, and storage of goods. 
 

 
• You apply incoming goods control procedures and manage delivery discrepancies with internal stakeholders. 
 

 
• You prepare, pick, pack, label, and dispatch customer and internal orders accurately and on time. 
 

 
• You supervise daily warehouse operations and coordinate team priorities to ensure efficient workflows. 
 
•  
You guide, support, and motivate the shipping and receiving clerks through hands-on leadership. 

 
• You enforce warehouse procedures and ensure compliance with safety, quality, and environmental standards. 
 

 
• You maintain inventory accuracy through cycle counts and effective stock control. 
 

 
• You monitor, analyse, and communicate warehouse performance and KPIs. 
 

 
• You identify and implement continuous improvement initiatives to increase efficiency and service levels. 

You are fluent in French and have a good command of English.

You have several years of experience in warehouse operations, shipping and receiving, or logistics coordination, including team coordination. You are highly organized, reliable, and committed to delivering accurate, high-quality results. 

You hold a valid forklift license and have experience operating warehouse handling equipment. 

You are familiar with ERP and warehouse management systems.

You communicate effectively and collaborate well with internal stakeholders across different departments. 

You lead by example and have the ability to guide, support, and motivate team members.

Our client is an international market leader in consumer electronics, with a strong presence in Belgium.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage and further develop the commercial partnership with the partner operating the four branded stores in Belgium.
• Build and maintain a strong relationship with a major Belgian telecom operator, ensuring its propositions are effectively integrated into the stores.
• Take commercial ownership of a business representing approximately. 
• Act as the central point of contact between the customer, telecom partner and internal Sales, Retail, Marketing and Supply Chain teams.
• Translate commercial strategies into concrete actions and initiatives at store level.
• Coordinate and follow up promotional plans across multiple product categories.
• Manage internal and external approval processes and ensure commercial initiatives are implemented correctly and on time.
• Prepare and monitor sales forecasts in close collaboration with Supply Chain.
• Analyze commercial performance and identify opportunities to further drive sales and business growth.
• Prepare and present commercial updates, results and business plans to key stakeholders.

• Similar experience in a commercial role such as Account Manager, Key Account Manager or Business Developer.
• Strong commercial mindset and comfortable taking ownership of an important customer portfolio.
• Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to navigate different and sometimes competing interests.
• Strong analytical capabilities and comfortable working with forecasting, sales data and commercial reporting.
• Confident communicator with strong presentation skills.
• Assertive and resilient: able to defend your position, ask the right questions and take ownership.
• Strong team player who enjoys working within an experienced and commercially driven team.
• Good command of Excel and PowerPoint.
• Fluent French and English are mandatory, with French required at a very strong professional level due to the customer and stakeholder environment.
• Dutch is an advantage, with a willingness to further develop the language considered important.

Are you looking for a stable job in a high-tech production environment where quality, innovation, and teamwork are at the heart of everything? We are recruiting a Production Operator/Production Worker for a leading company specializing in the packaging of nuts. You'll play a key role in maintaining an efficient production process while ensuring the highest quality standards.

Whether you're just starting your career or already have experience in manufacturing, we offer comprehensive training, ongoing support, and opportunities for career growth. As a Production Operator, you will work in a modern packaging facility equipped with advanced machinery, ensuring production runs smoothly and products meet our quality expectations.

Your Responsibilities

• Set up, operate, and adjust automated packaging and packing machines.

• Monitor product quality and ensure all packaged products meet company standards.

• Troubleshoot minor technical issues and perform basic maintenance tasks.

• Contribute to efficient production planning and continuous process improvement.

• Work closely with fellow operators and team leaders to achieve production targets.

• Maintain a clean, safe, and organized workplace in accordance with hygiene and safety regulations.

• You have initial experience working in a production or manufacturing environment, preferably within the fruit and vegetable industry.

• You have a good command of both Dutch and English.

• You have an affinity for technology and production processes.

• You are detail-oriented and committed to delivering high-quality work.

• You are a team player with a hands-on mentality.

• You are flexible and willing to work in shifts when required.

As a Business Analyst, you start from the business and its processes rather than from a predefined IT solution. You engage with various stakeholders, identify their challenges and needs, and seek to understand how processes actually work today.
You analyze the current way of working, identify bottlenecks and opportunities, and work together with the business to define a clear as-is and to-be situation. You ask critical questions, align different interests and help determine which changes can deliver the greatest added value.
You then translate these insights into clear business requirements, processes, objectives and solution directions. Throughout this process, you maintain a view of the bigger picture and ensure that proposed solutions align with operational reality and the broader digitalization strategy.
You work closely with Product Owners, Project Managers, Architects, Functional Analysts and development teams. While the more functional or technical profiles focus in greater detail on the concrete software implementation, you remain primarily responsible for the business context, process logic, scope and stakeholder alignment.
Throughout the project, you remain involved in validation and decision-making, ensuring that the final solution genuinely addresses the original business problem.

• 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst or in a similar role. More experience is certainly welcome
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree
• You have strong communication skills and can interact comfortably with operational employees, management and IT professionals
• You communicate professionally in English and understand Dutch and French

As part of a broad IT digitalization program, significant investments will be made over the coming years in renewing and optimizing processes, applications and digital services. To support this transformation, they are looking for an experienced Business Analyst who can immerse themselves in the business and help determine where and how digitalization can genuinely create value.
This is a long-term project within a stable enterprise environment, with contracts that can be renewed annually.

jobs.occupation: Inetum - Senior IT Recruiter (Permanent & Freelance Talent Solutions)
jobs.description:
Inetum is a European leader in digital services. Every day, the Group's 28,000 consultants and specialists aim to make a digital impact for businesses, public sector bodies and society as a whole: solutions that contribute to performance, innovation and the common good.

Present in 19 countries, close to the regions, and with its major software publisher partners, Inetum meets the challenges of digital transformation with proximity and flexibility. Driven by its ambition to grow and industrialize, Inetum generated Sales of EUR2.5 billion in 2023.

In response to a market that has been growing steadily for over 30 years, Inetum has made the deliberate choice to refocus on 4 core businesses in order to gain strength and offer customized solutions tailored to the specific needs of its customers: consulting (Inetum Consulting), infrastructure and application management (Inetum Technologies), software implementation (Inetum Solutions) and its own software publishing business (Inetum Software). Inetum has forged strategic partnerships with 4 of the world's leading software publishers - Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft and SAP - and is pursuing a dedicated acquisition strategy to become one of Europe's top 5 in these technologies, and offer the best expertise to its customers.

At inetum, we offer more than just a job; we provide an inspiring environment and opportunities for growth and development. we strive to create a workplace where you can harness your talents, contribute to challenging projects, and be part of a leading IT consultancy group.

Job description

 
• We are looking for an experienced Senior IT Recruiter to help us attract and engage top technology talent across Belgium. This is a role for someone who enjoys building relationships, identifying opportunities and finding solutions in a competitive talent market.
 
• You have a strong network within the IT sector, are comfortable approaching candidates directly, and know how to build credibility with both candidates and business stakeholders. You combine recruitment expertise with a commercial mindset and enjoy working closely with the business to achieve results.
 
• You will play a key role in attracting both permanent employees and freelance consultants, partnering closely with Business Unit Leaders and Sales teams to support the continued growth of the business.
 
• As a Senior IT Recruitment Partner, you will be responsible for the end-to-end recruitment process for both permanent and freelance IT positions. You will act as a trusted advisor to the business, bringing market insights, challenging assumptions and helping hiring managers make informed talent decisions.

Key responsibilities

 
• Manage the full recruitment lifecycle for permanent and freelance IT profiles
 
• Proactively source and engage high-quality candidates through LinkedIn, networking, referrals, events and other sourcing channels
 
• Build, maintain and leverage a strong network within the IT and technology market
 
• Conduct candidate interviews to ensure both technical and cultural fit
 
• Guide candidates throughout the recruitment process and create an excellent candidate experience
 
• Partner closely with Business Unit Leaders and Sales teams to understand hiring needs and business priorities
 
• Challenge and advise stakeholders on talent availability, market realities and recruitment strategies
 
• Develop creative sourcing approaches to identify niche and hard-to-find profiles
 
• Stay informed about technology trends and developments within the talent market
 
• Act as an ambassador for the company and contribute to strengthening our employer brand

Additional information

...

Experience & skills:

• Minimum 5 years of recruitment experience within IT or technology recruitment

• Proven experience recruiting both permanent employees and freelance consultants

• Strong sourcing capabilities with a track record of successfully filling challenging roles

• Well-established network within the IT and technology community

• Commercial mindset and strong relationship-building skills

• Able to influence, challenge and advise stakeholders at different levels of the organisation

• Genuine interest in technology and the IT market

• Resilient and persistent in your approach to recruitment

• Strong communication and negotiation skills

• Fluent in Dutch and English, both written and spoken

• Knowledge of French is an asset

Due to a large number of opportunities, we are looking for a driven 
Sales Coordinator / Tender Specialist to strengthen the Sarens Projects team. In this role, you aim to provide clients with a structured, solution-oriented, and clear proposal within the agreed timeline. In collaboration with the Key Account Manager, you clarify the proposal and respond to the client's questions. 
 

Your future responsibilities as a Tender Specialist include: 
 

• Analyzing and summarizing client requests. 
 

• Developing proposals for technical requests and projects in collaboration with the responsible Key Account Manager to achieve the best balance between budget, scope, and timing according to client needs. 
 

• During the bidding process, you collaborate with various support departments such as engineering, logistics, HR, SHEQ, finance, etc. You coordinate their input and deliverables while respecting deadlines to create a structured, high-quality proposal that meets both internal and external expectations. 
 

• Regularly consulting with the responsible Key Account Manager and the sales support team about the proposed solution, adjusting as needed. 
 

• Gathering the necessary cost inputs, preparing a price calculation, and reviewing it with the Key Account Manager and/or management. 
 

• Timely and accurately submitting proposals/tender documents after internal approval and following up on them with the Key Account Manager. Responding to internal and external questions and making adjustments where needed. 
 

• Acting at all times as a proud 
Sarens Ambassador and providing general sales support to the group. 

We are looking for a stress-resistant multitasker with a hands-on mentality, strong writing skills, and a solution-focused, positive attitude. You have a strong interest in the world of specialized transport and heavy lifting. You possess good reading and listening skills, enabling you to detect and anticipate customer needs. You think outside the box in search of the best solution. You are a sociable team player with a strong sense of responsibility. You work in a structured and precise manner, with attention to detail. Customer focus, drive, and proactivity are key to success in this role. 
 

Your profile: 
 

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a technical field (engineering, electromechanics, construction...) or equivalent through experience. 
 

• Interest in or experience with sales support, technical inside sales, tender engineering, etc. 
 

• Technical knowledge of heavy lifting and/or exceptional transport, or a strong eagerness to learn and acquire this knowledge quickly. • Strong communicator in Dutch; good knowledge of English and French. 
 

• Proficient with computers (including MS Office).
